evidence.quote: Established in 1976, it is one of the very few companies worldwide to combine traditional Steel Machining with Powder Metal technologies and has achieved over the years a remarkable position in the manufacturing of gears and components. || Schramberg Germany Founded in 1958 Area m2 Employees Padova Italy Founded in 1976 Area m2 Employees Suzhou China Founded in 2003
